visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven final portable views against individually viewed 2010 and 2014 local exterior photographs and supplemental brick/sign details. Three stories, red Pearl Street and buff Broad Street facades, sash windows, columned entry, attic dormers, tall chimneys and roof balustrade are represented. Review corrected overlapping foundation surfaces, dormer side winding and solid balcony side panels.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all seven final shared-material views plus full entrance and rear views. Review replaced the prominently seamed Flemish graph with the standard shared brick surface; its running bond is an explicit medium-fi approximation. Foundation surfaces no longer overlap, and balcony sides have open rails. Brick, wood, stone, painted metal and roof tile have metric bindings; glass is local. Flat terrain here is a material fixture; independent terrain remains in the portable scene.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all nineteen final lighting, quality and forced-detail frames. Skyline retains three chimneys, roof platform and entry; district adds windows and dormers; street and closeup preserve sash divisions, porch rails and balustrades. Synthetic neighbors are style fixtures. No physical-device frame-rate measurement is claimed.

fidelityReview.scope: Restored Fraunces Tavern corner building at 54 Pearl Street; neighboring museum buildings, rear connector and interiors excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Individually inspected local 2010 corner and 2014 Pearl Street photographs, buff-brick detail and projecting sign. Official city descriptions and district map corroborate the three-story scope and roof details. Local caption calling the buff face south is corrected to west/Broad Street. Vertical dimensions, hidden roof surfaces, service openings, brick bond and fine profiles remain approximations. No exact 1783 reconstruction or copied sign artwork/photo pixels is claimed.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four current levels were visually inspected and pass budgets; exact triangle and byte counts are recorded in levels. Simplified roof rails and sash divisions reduce distant detail while preserving the silhouette. Error values are authoring budgets, not measured mesh deviations.

geometryValidation.notes: Exact regeneration, ordinary import verification, four current LOD checks and strict medium-fi audit passed. Source bundle, scene and terrain schemas pass; independent terrain PNG encoding error is recorded above. No independent Khronos-validator run is claimed.

limitations: Original medium-fi exterior of the restored 54 Pearl Street corner building, informed by individually inspected Qualla 2010/2014 photographs and supplemental details plus official city architectural descriptions. Not a survey or exact 1783 reconstruction.
101 Broad Street, 58 Pearl Street, other museum buildings, interiors and the narrow mapped rear connector are excluded. Scope clipping is an explicit authoring boundary.
Mapped 14.6 m height is only an approximate roof/balustrade control; chimneys rise above it. Vertical dimensions, hidden roof surfaces and service-side windows remain interpretations.

Twelve-over-twelve sash, jack arches, paneled cornice and roof balusters are simplified geometry. The standard shared brick surface approximates the photographed Flemish bond without the pronounced repeat seam of the current Flemish graph. Sign portrait and lettering, flags, interior details and photograph pixels are not reproduced.
Independent terrain remains unchanged with foundation below the sidewalk datum. Exact contact can differ with another host DEM.
